title: Section opener: the four-layer title block, its decoration group, a yellow column with a survey ruler and a hatched ghost word over contours
use: The opening of a page section, or a section card in a deck. tone=dark sets it on navy for the lore and media sections.

ruler.note: a survey ruler and datum mark on the column

relations: Arrow block 78 x 24, Latin 27 (set 21 in the wide face), CJK 36, 6 between: the reference's sizes at 1920, kept at the card's own 960 width so the title reads at deck scale; one left edge.
The column is square-cornered and full height; the ghost word sits behind the title and the column.
decoration: Contours, the hatched ghost word, the ruler and datum mark, the decoration group: drawn.

provenance.corpus: traverse case (远垦导线 TRAVERSE): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the frontier-survey grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/frontier-survey/style.json provenance (reference site measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: The case's section title (all eight sections) at half scale on a 960 x 540 card; sizes from the reference's computed styles.
measured: Reference: SectionTitle arrow block 78 x 24 #D9D9D9, Latin 27 px line 24, CJK 36 px bold, at x 209 (119 into the content).
Case first pass: the micro path label in #8C8C8C measured 3.36:1 on white; it is #6B6B6B now.
